<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
<title id="title">Sloth operating an excavator on a sunny construction site</title>
<desc id="desc">A cartoon sloth in a hard hat and high-visibility vest calmly digs with a yellow tracked excavator, complete with animated arm, steering wheel, rolling tracks, blinking eyes, floating Zzz, exhaust puffs, clouds and a bird.</desc>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5FB8F0"/><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#9ADCF7"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFF2B8"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F0C87A"/><stop offset="45%" stop-color="#E0A95E"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C68B42"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="yellowMetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD93B"/><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#F7B500"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E08A00"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="yellowDark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F7B500"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C96F00"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="trackGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4B535A"/><stop offset="50%" stop-color="#2E3338"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1C1F22"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="windowGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#BDEFFF"/><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#7ED0F2"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4AA8D8"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="dirtGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B07A3F"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7A4F22"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="dirtLight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D99A55"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A66E33"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="sunGrad"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF8A0"/><stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FFD93B"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF9F1C"/></radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="shadowGrad"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.28"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
  <pattern id="stripes" width="28" height="28" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
    <rect width="14" height="28" fill="#FFD23F"/><rect x="14" width="14" height="28" fill="#222222"/>
  </pattern>
  <pattern id="dots" width="46" height="34" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
    <circle cx="8" cy="10" r="3" fill="#8A5A28" opacity="0.45"/><circle cx="28" cy="22" r="2.2" fill="#6B4119" opacity="0.4"/><circle cx="40" cy="7" r="2" fill="#E8B96F" opacity="0.6"/>
  </pattern>
</defs>
<style>
  .cloudA{animation:drift 55s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
  .cloudB{animation:drift 70s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse}
  .cloudC{animation:drift 48s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
  @keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(-18px)}to{transform:translateX(42px)}}
  .rays{animation:spin 42s linear infinite;transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box}
  .roller,.wheelSpin,.gear{animation:spin 3.2s linear infinite;transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box}
  .wheelSpin{animation-duration:9s}
  .gear{animation-duration:5s}
  @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  .trackDash{animation:dash 1.1s linear infinite}
  @keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-60}}
  .boomSwing{animation:boom 4.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:660px 542px}
  @keyframes boom{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-3.5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(4.5deg)}}
  .stickSwing{animation:stick 4.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:858px 422px}
  @keyframes stick{0%,100%{transform:rotate(6deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-8deg)}}
  .bucketScoop{animation:scoop 4.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:1002px 562px}
  @keyframes scoop{0%,100%{transform:rotate(10deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-14deg)}}
  .headBob{animation:bob 4.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:435px 445px}
  @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-1.6deg) translateY(0)}50%{transform:rotate(1.8deg) translateY(3px)}}
  .blink{animation:blink 5.2s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box}
  @keyframes blink{0%,91%,100%{transform:scaleY(0)}95%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
  .zzz{animation:zzz 4.2s ease-in infinite;opacity:0;font-family:Verdana,sans-serif;font-weight:900;fill:#5B4632}
  .zzz2{animation-delay:1.4s}.zzz3{animation-delay:2.8s}
  @keyframes zzz{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.7);opacity:0}25%{opacity:1}80%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(26px,-58px) scale(1.25) rotate(12deg);opacity:0}}
  .puff{animation:puff 3.4s ease-out infinite;opacity:0}
  .p2{animation-delay:1.1s}.p3{animation-delay:2.2s}
  @keyframes puff{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.5);opacity:0}18%{opacity:.85}100%{transform:translate(18px,-78px) scale(1.9);opacity:0}}
  .birdFly{animation:fly 26s linear infinite}
  @keyframes fly{0%{transform:translate(-160px,118px)}25%{transform:translate(320px,88px)}50%{transform:translate(640px,122px)}75%{transform:translate(960px,92px)}100%{transform:translate(1400px,112px)}}
  .wing{animation:flap .55s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box}
  @keyframes flap{from{transform:scaleY(.4)}to{transform:scaleY(1.15)}}
  .dirtFall{animation:fall 4.6s ease-in infinite;opacity:0}
  .d2{animation-delay:.35s}.d3{animation-delay:.7s}
  @keyframes fall{0%{transform:translate(0,0);opacity:0}28%{opacity:1}62%{transform:translate(-8px,42px);opacity:0}100%{transform:translate(-8px,42px);opacity:0}}
  .sunPulse{animation:pulse 6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.06)}}
  .flagWave{animation:wave 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:left center;transform-box:fill-box}
  @keyframes wave{from{transform:skewY(-4deg)}to{transform:skewY(5deg)}}
</style>

<!-- SKY -->
<rect width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#sky)"/>
<!-- distant hills and city -->
<path d="M0 470 L140 410 L300 455 L470 395 L650 450 L830 400 L1010 450 L1200 415 L1200 545 L0 545 Z" fill="#8EC9A8" opacity="0.55"/>
<path d="M0 500 L200 455 L420 495 L700 450 L950 495 L1200 460 L1200 560 L0 560 Z" fill="#F2D492" opacity="0.75"/>
<g opacity="0.28" fill="#5A7A8A">
  <rect x="52" y="395" width="52" height="95"/><rect x="116" y="415" width="38" height="75"/><rect x="1028" y="400" width="46" height="90"/><rect x="1086" y="425" width="36" height="65"/>
</g>
<!-- crane silhouette -->
<g stroke="#3D5A66" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5" fill="none">
  <path d="M72 500 L72 300 M72 300 L210 300 M72 320 L150 300 M150 372 L150 300"/>
</g>
<line x1="150" y1="372" x2="150" y2="408" stroke="#3D5A66" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="138" y="408" width="24" height="16" fill="#3D5A66" opacity="0.5"/>

<!-- SUN -->
<g class="sunPulse">
  <g class="rays" fill="#FFB703" opacity="0.85">
    <path d="M1048 18 L1056 52 L1040 52 Z"/><path d="M1048 202 L1040 168 L1056 168 Z"/><path d="M948 110 L982 102 L982 118 Z"/><path d="M1148 110 L1114 118 L1114 102 Z"/>
    <path d="M978 40 L1004 62 L994 74 Z"/><path d="M1118 180 L1092 158 L1102 146 Z"/><path d="M1118 40 L1092 62 L1102 74 Z"/><path d="M978 180 L1004 158 L994 146 Z"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="1048" cy="110" r="56" fill="url(#sunGrad)" stroke="#FF9F1C" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="1030" cy="92" r="14" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.55"/>
</g>

<!-- CLOUDS -->
<g class="cloudA" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.96">
  <ellipse cx="210" cy="105" rx="72" ry="28"/><ellipse cx="260" cy="88" rx="52" ry="26"/><ellipse cx="160" cy="90" rx="38" ry="20"/>
</g>
<g class="cloudB" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.92">
  <ellipse cx="560" cy="72" rx="62" ry="23"/><ellipse cx="600" cy="58" rx="42" ry="20"/><ellipse cx="520" cy="60" rx="30" ry="16"/>
</g>
<g class="cloudC" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">
  <ellipse cx="780" cy="160" rx="52" ry="19"/><ellipse cx="815" cy="148" rx="34" ry="16"/>
</g>

<!-- BIRD -->
<g class="birdFly">
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="20" ry="9" fill="#2F4A5A"/>
    <circle cx="17" cy="-5" r="7" fill="#2F4A5A"/><path d="M23 -5 L34 -2 L23 0 Z" fill="#FF9F1C"/>
    <path class="wing" d="M-2 -2 Q-14 -22 2 -10 Q10 -18 6 -2 Z" fill="#4A728A"/>
  </g>
</g>

<!-- GROUND -->
<rect x="0" y="510" width="1200" height="290" fill="url(#ground)"/>
<rect x="0" y="510" width="1200" height="290" fill="url(#dots)" opacity="0.55"/>
<path d="M0 510 L1200 510 L1200 535 Q600 520 0 535 Z" fill="#FFE3A3" opacity="0.7"/>
<!-- road / work pad -->
<ellipse cx="500" cy="720" rx="360" ry="42" fill="url(#shadowGrad)"/>
<path d="M80 730 Q600 690 1120 735 L1120 760 Q600 730 80 760 Z" fill="#B98A4A" opacity="0.45"/>

<!-- BACK DIRT PILE LEFT -->
<path d="M40 640 Q120 560 210 640 Z" fill="url(#dirtGrad)"/>
<path d="M90 615 Q130 590 175 620 Q140 635 90 615Z" fill="#D99A55"/>
<!-- ROCKS -->
<g fill="#9A938A" stroke="#6E675F" stroke-width="2">
  <path d="M95 700 L125 685 L150 700 L140 718 L105 718 Z"/><path d="M1085 720 L1115 705 L1145 722 L1130 740 L1095 738 Z"/>
  <path d="M170 750 L195 740 L215 752 L205 766 L178 764 Z" fill="#B0A69C"/>
</g>

<!-- MAIN DIRT PILE RIGHT -->
<g>
  <path d="M825 665 Q960 540 1135 625 Q1180 645 1200 660 L1200 800 L825 800 Z" fill="url(#dirtGrad)"/>
  <path d="M880 630 Q970 565 1055 615 Q1000 650 880 630Z" fill="url(#dirtLight)"/>
  <circle cx="960" cy="640" r="9" fill="#7A4F22"/><circle cx="1030" cy="665" r="7" fill="#5E3A16"/><circle cx="1100" cy="640" r="8" fill="#D99A55"/>
  <circle cx="920" cy="680" r="6" fill="#5E3A16"/><circle cx="1080" cy="700" r="10" fill="#8A5A28"/>
  <path d="M900 660 Q960 620 1030 650" fill="none" stroke="#8A5A28" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
</g>

<!-- CONSTRUCTION DETAILS: cones -->
<g>
  <g transform="translate(118 618)">
    <path d="M0 62 L28 0 L56 62 Z" fill="#FF6B1A" stroke="#C94F00" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M14 34 L42 34 L48 48 L8 48 Z" fill="#FFF"/><rect x="-8" y="58" width="72" height="10" rx="3" fill="#C94F00"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(1092 688) scale(.82)">
    <path d="M0 62 L28 0 L56 62 Z" fill="#FF6B1A" stroke="#C94F00" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M14 34 L42 34 L48 48 L8 48 Z" fill="#FFF"/><rect x="-8" y="58" width="72" height="10" rx="3" fill="#C94F00"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(168 700) scale(.6)">
    <path d="M0 62 L28 0 L56 62 Z" fill="#FF6B1A" stroke="#C94F00" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="-8" y="58" width="72" height="10" rx="3" fill="#C94F00"/>
  </g>
</g>

<!-- CAUTION BARRIER LEFT FOREGROUND -->
<g>
  <rect x="22" y="590" width="14" height="130" fill="#8A5A28"/><rect x="178" y="590" width="14" height="130" fill="#8A5A28"/>
  <rect x="14" y="575" width="186" height="38" rx="5" fill="url(#stripes)" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="14" y="628" width="186" height="24" rx="5" fill="url(#stripes)" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.9"/>
  <g class="flagWave"><path d="M36 575 L78 575 L70 592 L36 592 Z" fill="#FF6B1A"/></g>
</g>
<!-- caution tape to right -->
<path d="M200 600 Q350 585 470 600" fill="none" stroke="#FFD23F" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="18 10"/><path d="M200 600 Q350 585 470 600" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="18 10" opacity="0.4"/>

<!-- WORK SIGN -->
<g transform="translate(1025 505)">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="118" height="72" rx="8" fill="#FFF" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="59" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="900" fill="#C94F00">SLOW</text>
  <text x="59" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#222">WORK ZONE</text>
  <rect x="50" y="72" width="10" height="38" fill="#666"/>
</g>

<!-- EXCAVATOR SHADOW -->
<ellipse cx="490" cy="725" rx="330" ry="30" fill="#000" opacity="0.18"/>

<!-- TRACKS -->
<g>
  <rect x="205" y="600" width="570" height="112" rx="56" fill="url(#trackGrad)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="222" y="618" width="536" height="76" rx="38" fill="#3E454C" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect class="trackDash" x="222" y="618" width="536" height="76" rx="38" fill="none" stroke="#15181B" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="20 14" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- rollers -->
  <g fill="#C9D1D6" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3">
    <g class="roller"><circle cx="285" cy="656" r="27"/><path d="M285 632 L285 680 M261 656 L309 656 M268 639 L302 673 M302 639 L268 673" stroke="#5A656E" stroke-width="4"/></g>
    <g class="roller"><circle cx="375" cy="656" r="24"/><path d="M375 634 L375 678 M353 656 L397 656" stroke="#5A656E" stroke-width="4"/></g>
    <g class="roller"><circle cx="465" cy="656" r="24"/><path d="M465 634 L465 678 M443 656 L487 656" stroke="#5A656E" stroke-width="4"/></g>
    <g class="roller"><circle cx="555" cy="656" r="24"/><path d="M555 634 L555 678 M533 656 L577 656" stroke="#5A656E" stroke-width="4"/></g>
    <g class="roller"><circle cx="645" cy="656" r="24"/><path d="M645 634 L645 678 M623 656 L667 656" stroke="#5A656E" stroke-width="4"/></g>
  </g>
  <circle cx="240" cy="656" r="34" fill="#8A949C" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="240" cy="656" r="12" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="725" cy="656" r="34" fill="#8A949C" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="725" cy="656" r="12" fill="#333"/>
  <g fill="#FFD23F" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="240" cy="644" r="4"/><circle cx="240" cy="668" r="4"/><circle cx="228" cy="656" r="4"/><circle cx="252" cy="656" r="4"/></g>
</g>

<!-- TURRET / BODY -->
<g>
  <rect x="270" y="540" width="450" height="78" rx="14" fill="url(#yellowMetal)" stroke="#8A4F00" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="270" y="540" width="450" height="18" rx="9" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- counterweight -->
  <path d="M268 545 Q240 545 238 585 Q240 620 275 618 L295 618 L295 545 Z" fill="url(#yellowDark)" stroke="#8A4F00" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- engine vents -->
  <g fill="#8A4F00" opacity="0.85"><rect x="580" y="560" width="52" height="8" rx="3"/><rect x="580" y="576" width="52" height="8" rx="3"/><rect x="580" y="592" width="52" height="8" rx="3"/></g>
  <circle cx="315" cy="602" r="6" fill="#8A4F00"/><circle cx="695" cy="602" r="6" fill="#8A4F00"/>
  <!-- side stripe -->
  <rect x="295" y="598" width="400" height="8" fill="#222" opacity="0.25"/>
</g>

<!-- EXHAUST PIPE -->
<g>
  <rect x="585" y="460" width="20" height="86" rx="4" fill="#5A656E" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="578" y="452" width="34" height="14" rx="4" fill="#333"/>
  <g fill="#E8E8E8" stroke="#B0B0B0" stroke-width="1.5">
    <circle class="puff" cx="595" cy="448" r="15"/>
    <circle class="puff p2" cx="595" cy="448" r="12"/>
    <circle class="puff p3" cx="595" cy="448" r="17"/>
  </g>
</g>

<!-- CAB -->
<g>
  <path d="M325 545 L325 410 Q325 378 358 378 L520 378 Q552 378 552 410 L552 545 Z" fill="url(#yellowMetal)" stroke="#8A4F00" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="345" y="400" width="188" height="118" rx="12" fill="url(#windowGrad)" stroke="#2F6B8A" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M360 410 L420 410 L380 505 L350 505 Z" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.35"/>
  <path d="M435 405 L460 405 L425 500 L408 500 Z" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.22"/>
  <!-- cab details -->
  <rect x="345" y="525" width="188" height="12" fill="#8A4F00" opacity="0.35"/>
  <circle cx="535" cy="395" r="5" fill="#8A4F00"/>
  <rect x="500" y="545" width="36" height="10" rx="4" fill="#333"/>
</g>

<!-- SLOTH inside cab -->
<g>
  <!-- torso vest -->
  <path d="M378 545 Q435 505 492 545 L492 575 L378 575 Z" fill="#FF7A1A" stroke="#C94F00" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="378" y="540" width="114" height="10" fill="#D9E021"/><rect x="378" y="555" width="114" height="9" fill="#C0C8CC" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M405 525 L420 575 M465 525 L450 575" stroke="#FFD93B" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- arm to steering wheel (behind head bunch, in front of vest) -->
  <path d="M470 535 Q505 520 522 532" fill="none" stroke="#8D7358" stroke-width="19" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M522 532 L538 524 M524 536 L540 536 M522 540 L536 546" stroke="#4A3826" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- other arm resting -->
  <path d="M390 540 Q375 555 388 568" fill="none" stroke="#8D7358" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- HEAD group bobbing -->
  <g class="headBob">
    <circle cx="378" cy="438" r="15" fill="#A98A6D" stroke="#7A6248" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="492" cy="438" r="15" fill="#A98A6D" stroke="#7A6248" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="435" cy="442" r="60" fill="#A98A6D" stroke="#7A6248" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="435" cy="448" rx="45" ry="38" fill="#EDE2CC"/>
    <!-- eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx="412" cy="436" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#5C4632" transform="rotate(-18 412 436)"/>
    <ellipse cx="460" cy="436" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#5C4632" transform="rotate(18 460 436)"/>
    <!-- sleepy half-closed eyes -->
    <circle cx="412" cy="440" r="5.5" fill="#1A120B"/><circle cx="460" cy="440" r="5.5" fill="#1A120B"/>
    <path d="M402 433 Q412 438 422 433" fill="none" stroke="#1A120B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M450 433 Q460 438 470 433" fill="none" stroke="#1A120B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- blinking eyelids -->
    <g class="blink"><ellipse cx="412" cy="436" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#A98A6D"/><ellipse cx="460" cy="436" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#A98A6D"/></g>
    <!-- nose & smile -->
    <ellipse cx="436" cy="464" rx="10" ry="7.5" fill="#3B2A1A"/>
    <path d="M418 478 Q436 490 454 478" fill="none" stroke="#5C4632" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="398" cy="462" r="7" fill="#D9B88A" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="474" cy="462" r="7" fill="#D9B88A" opacity="0.6"/>
    <!-- hard hat -->
    <path d="M378 418 Q435 362 492 418 Q492 430 435 430 Q378 430 378 418Z" fill="#FFD23F" stroke="#C99200" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="435" cy="422" rx="72" ry="13" fill="#FFD23F" stroke="#C99200" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M435 368 L435 418" stroke="#C99200" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="410" cy="392" rx="18" ry="9" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.5" transform="rotate(-18 410 392)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- STEERING WHEEL rotating -->
  <g class="wheelSpin">
    <circle cx="528" cy="533" r="27" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="7"/>
    <circle cx="528" cy="533" r="27" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M528 506 L528 560 M501 533 L555 533 M509 514 L547 552 M547 514 L509 552" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="528" cy="533" r="9" fill="#FFD23F" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <!-- paw over wheel again for grip illusion -->
  <ellipse cx="530" cy="530" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#8D7358" stroke="#5C4632" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M522 524 L518 518 M530 522 L530 515 M538 524 L542 518" stroke="#4A3826" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</g>

<!-- Zzz -->
<text class="zzz" x="500" y="395" font-size="26">Z</text>
<text class="zzz zzz2" x="515" y="380" font-size="20">z</text>
<text class="zzz zzz3" x="495" y="365" font-size="16">z</text>

<!-- BOOM / STICK / BUCKET -->
<g class="boomSwing">
  <!-- hydraulic -->
  <path d="M670 530 L800 445" stroke="#C0C8CC" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M670 530 L800 445" stroke="#5A656E" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- boom body -->
  <path d="M640 525 L660 508 L875 398 L890 430 L690 565 Z" fill="url(#yellowMetal)" stroke="#8A4F00" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M665 520 L870 410 L870 425 L680 540 Z" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.55"/>
  <circle cx="660" cy="542" r="17" fill="#333" stroke="#111" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="660" cy="542" r="7" fill="#C0C8CC"/>

Created valid, standalone animated SVG at `output.svg` (1200×800 viewBox, 21.7 KB) in the current directory.

Includes:
- Sky with pulsing sun/rotating rays, drifting clouds, flying bird, hills, crane & city silhouette
- Warm ground, dirt piles, cones, rocks, caution-striped barrier/tape, and “SLOW WORK ZONE” sign
- Tracked excavator with rotating track rollers/treads, turret body, cab window, exhaust pipe, boom + stick + toothed bucket
- Sloth in cab with hard hat, orange hi-vis vest, face mask/eye patches, half-closed blinking eyes, nose/sleepy smile, clawed arm to steering wheel
- **7+ continuous animations:** digging boom/stick/bucket cycle, spinning steering wheel, rolling tracks/rollers, blinking, head-bobbing, floating “Zzz”, exhaust puffs, drifting clouds, bird crossing, falling dirt, and rotating sun rays

All gradients, styles, and animations are inline CSS/SMIL-free (no JavaScript, no external images/fonts/scripts).
